audit_scope.description: Batch 12 covers EL internal EVM operations including instruction execution, comparison opcodes, control flow, and internal state management. These are primarily computational operations within the EVM interpreter.

in_scope: EVM comparison instructions (LT, GT, SLT, SGT, EQ, ISZERO)

trusted_external_entities.name: Users via Contract Deployment - Bytecode Opcodes
trusted_external_entities.rationale: Users deploy smart contracts containing arbitrary bytecode sequences. While bytecode execution is deterministic, the deployed opcodes control program flow and can attempt invalid operations (stack underflow, invalid jumps, out-of-gas). EVM must enforce all opcode validation rules and gas limits.

boundary_edges.security_assumption: Deployed bytecode may contain any opcode sequences. EVM must validate: stack has sufficient items before opcode execution, memory expansions are within gas budget, jumps target valid JUMPDEST locations, gas is charged for every operation. Invalid opcodes cause exceptional halt. All operations must be bounded by gas limit.

coverage_gaps.reason: Batch 12 is focused on internal EVM opcode execution logic. External interaction is limited to the initial contract deployment that provides the bytecode. Once deployed, execution is purely internal state transitions.
